description: Windkraftanlagen Eignungszonen Burgenland is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten.bgld.gv.at. Suitability zones for the construction of wind turbines. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbines Suitability zones Burgenland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Windkraftanlagen, Burgenland, Eignungszone. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
